catastrophe.name: The Fracture
catastrophe.cause: Nuclear war shattered Earth into floating islands.

geography.landform: Fractured continents and floating rock islands above an atmospheric void
geography.boundaries: Map labels mark regions of influence, not surveyed borders.

magnetic_fields.behavior: Erratic and turbulent in motion, but their patterns are predictable.
magnetic_fields.navigation: Ships use magnetic motors to travel through the fields between cities and mining sites.

humanity.adaptation: Survivors evolved over generations under the influence of the magnetic fields.

gravity_and_energy.city_support: Magneton technology stabilizes floating cities and islands, preventing them from falling.
gravity_and_energy.local_gravity: Generated local fields reproduce the experience of the old Earth’s gravity.
gravity_and_energy.power: Oppositely polarized metal components move in magnetic motors, powering city and transport systems.
gravity_and_energy.fictional_physics: These are rules of the setting; no real-world scientific mechanism is established.

properties: Most malleable of the Magneton types
Impenetrable and impervious to any weapons

characters.name: Rovan’s five honour-guard captains
characters.uniform_standard: Continuous silver coverage with no joints or gaps. Crimson capes, sashes and tabards are worn over the sealed armour; cloth is never a gap in the metal.

equipment.armour_construction: Practical man-made brushed silver with tool marks and restrained machined details; sealed continuous coverage with no joints or gaps.
equipment.armour_detail: Brushed silver shells with narrow aged brass edging, small fittings and chased geometric details. Crimson enamel badges show Veymarch’s silver broken shield and eight-point star.

objects.name: Magneton Type C
objects.description: Silvery metal. Most malleable of the Magneton types; Impenetrable and impervious to any weapons; Can drift along magnetic fields

objects.name: Magnetic lance
objects.description: Condenses magnetic fields and fires the concentrated energy like a cannon.

objects.name: Field broadsword
objects.description: Condenses magnetic fields into a larger blade capable of cutting through a ship’s hull.

objects.name: Twin wind swords
objects.description: A pair of wind-like swords that lets the wielder fly like a bird.

objects.name: Shield war hammer
objects.description: Creates its own magnetic field when slammed down, forming a shield against Tesla guns.

objects.name: Magnetic scythe
objects.description: Lets the wielder jump between two concentrated points of magnetic energy.

objects.name: Veymarch banner
objects.description: Crimson field; Silver broken shield and star
